title: Session personas
description: GET /v1/personas. The built-in personas a session can be launched as (docs/personas.md): a role definition written into the session's system prompt at launch. The catalog is compiled into the daemon; the texts themselves never travel on this route.

PersonaNames.description: A name or a one-sentence summary in the two languages the console speaks.

Persona.description: One persona. `id` is what a start or resume path ends `/as/{id}` with, what a dispatch's `persona` and a Root Assignment's `persona` name, and what a session row's `persona` reads back.

suggested_kinds.description: Board item kinds (epic, feature, issue) this persona is offered for first. A suggestion: nothing is given a persona nobody chose.

icon.description: The persona's pixel bot, eight columns by seven rows, in the shape a project's mark has.

source.description: The upstream file this persona was adapted from, at a fixed commit.

PersonaCatalog.description: Every persona in the order a picker shows them, and where the texts came from.

license.description: The upstream licence the texts are adapted under, by its SPDX name (MIT).
